user_id.description: Opaque canonical Glean user ID. Other Platform APIs, such as usage limits, accept and return this ID.

display_name.description: The name that Glean shows for the user.

alias_emails.description: The user's other email addresses, sorted, without the primary email. Absent when the user has none or the workspace does not show alias emails.

user_type.description: Employment status or account type. Absent when the workspace hides the employee type attribute.
user_type.title: PlatformPersonType

department.description: The user's department. Absent when the user has no department.

department_id.description: Opaque department ID. The users and departments APIs return the same ID for the same department. A renamed department gets a new ID.

display_name.description: Department name, exactly as the directory stores it.

department.title: PlatformDepartmentReference

manager.description: The user's direct manager. Absent when the user has no manager or the manager is not in the directory.

user_id.description: Opaque canonical Glean user ID of the manager.

display_name.description: The name that Glean shows for the manager.

manager.title: PlatformUserManager

datasource_profiles.description: The user's accounts in connected apps. Present only when include contains DATASOURCE_PROFILES. Each account appears once, even when more than one connected app instance reports it.

items.description: A user's account in a connected app.

datasource.description: Datasource of the account, for example slack or github.

handle.description: The account's handle or display name in the app.

account_id.description: The app's own ID for the account. Present only when Glean knows it, for example the Slack user ID.

profile_url.description: Web URL of the account's profile.

items.title: PlatformUserDatasourceProfile
